title: Understanding the Expression
text: To determine the dimensions of the expression $X_i\cdot{\theta}**{(t)}$, consider the dimensions of $X_i$ and $\theta**{(t)}$.

title: Dimensions of $X_i$
text: $X_i$ is a vector containing the values in the $i$'th row of the design matrix $X$. What are the dimensions of $X_i$?

title: Dimensions of $\theta**{(t)}$
text: $\theta**{(t)}$ is a vector containing the model weights. What are the dimensions of $\theta**{(t)}$?

title: Matrix Multiplication
text: Given that $X_i$ is a length $p$ vector and $\theta**{(t)}$ is also a length $p$ vector, what is the result of their dot product?
